entities.summary: The Battle of Banquan was a legendary battle in ancient Chinese history, said to have taken place c. 2500 BC. It was recorded by Sima Qian's Records of the Grand Historian. It was fought by Huangdi, the Yellow Emperor, and Yandi, the Flame Emperor.
